title: Normalized module and scalar comparisons along a profinite section
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a condensed ring, $r:V\to S$ and $s:S\to V$ continuous maps of profinite spaces with $r\circ s=\operatorname{id}_S$, and let $a$ be a normalized Slice inverse image along $r$ [lem-zl-component-derived-pullback-square]. There is SectionComparison data [def-zl-condensed-generic-scalar-model-data]: a normalized Slice along $s$, the iterated test-pullback identity with its first-projection formula, its adjunction-mate identity on abelian sheaves, its lift $s^*r^*\cong\operatorname{id}$ on modules, and the scalar comparison $s^*q_V^*\cong q_S^*$ with the specified underlying absolute-test map.

proof.text: construct the slice inverse image along s by sheafified left Kan extension along Over.pullback s. Its standard adjunction and monoidal structure give the canonical Slice data; the absolute-test base-change isomorphism gives beta. Since s followed by r is the identity, the iterated test pullback is naturally isomorphic to the identity, with underlying map the two first projections. Take its adjunction mate to obtain abelian; the conjugate equality is the stated abelian_mate. The coefficient restrictions are all from the same Lambda, so lift abelian to the ordinary module comparison, with the same underlying map. Similarly lift inverse.beta to the scalar module comparison. Naturality and monoidality verify linearity. These constructions give all fields of SectionComparison with their specified underlying maps. Empty profinite spaces and the zero ring require no separate choices.
